newsitem.title: RUSSIA: At leas four die in Russian blast.
newsitem.headline: At leas four die in Russian blast.

text.p: At least four people died on Monday when a powerful explosion destroyed a two-storey office building in a remote Russian settlement, a spokeswoman for the emergency ministry said.
The spokeswoman said about 30 people were in the building at the time of the blast. Twelve survivors and four bodies had been recovered from the debris during the first hour of rescue work, she said.
The explosion, which was believed to had been caused by a kitchen gas canister, took place near the town of Kueda 250 km (155 miles) south of the regional centre of Perm in the Urals.
The spokeswoman could not indicate the condition of the survivors.
Itar-Tass news agency said most of the residents of the settlement worked at a small oil refinery.
Local rescue teams rushed to the scene and more rescuers from the Emergencies ministry are expected to be sent from Moscow later in the day.
